text: Okay, let me see here. I wanted the 17-inch one, but the 256GB SSD is a bit low, yeah. Hmm. The 15-inch one has more RAM, but I really liked the 17-inch size. Do you think I could get the 17-inch one with maybe a 512GB SSD instead? Or is that not an option?
zh: 好的，让我看看。我本来想要17英寸的，但256GB SSD有点低，对吧。嗯。15英寸的有更多内存，但我真的很喜欢17英寸的尺寸。您觉得我能不能拿到17英寸的，也许换成512GB SSD？或者那不是选项吗？
